name: Jayanti Mangala Kali
text:
जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी ।
दुर्गा क्षमा शिवा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
meaning: Salutations to the victorious and auspicious Kali, Bhadrakali, the protective one, Durga, forgiveness, auspiciousness and the sustaining mother.
purpose: A Devi praise verse that invokes protective and transformative qualities.
supports: Courage; meeting fear; protective boundaries; remembering fierce compassion.
when: During a devotional practice focused on strength and protection.
note: The client list places it on Thursday; the library cross-lists it on Tuesday by theme. It belongs to both.
source: Argala Stotram, recited with the Devi Mahatmya
